g.title: scaler_nearest
g.text: out(ox, oy) = in(round(src_x), round(src_y)) - no arithmetic on the pixels
1 output pixel per clock - latency: one input frame (default, PINGPONG) or a few lines (LINE_BUF)
pixel = CHANNELS x COMP_W bits (default 3 x 8), component 0 in the LSBs

g.title: regbus
g.text: AW and W in any order, OKAY responses

g.title: ctrl
g.text: capture FSM: SOF / EOL checks, writes the

g.title: dda
g.text: exact accumulation, SOF / EOL / EOF flags
stalls with the pipeline (adv), hold for LINE_BUF

g.title: fb
g.text: 1 x 1: one RAM bank, one pixel every clock

g.title: dp
g.text: the 1x1 window is the output pixel:
no multipliers, no coefficients, no IP registers
